entities.name: Drasus
entities.description: One of Kytheon Iora's irregulars from Akros, three years older than Kytheon and hot-tempered.

entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: Friend of Drasus who threw Heliod's spear.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God whose spear was thrown by Kytheon.

events.summary: Drasus was imprisoned in Akros for brawling.
events.quote: Drasus was imprisoned in Akros for brawling

events.summary: Drasus took part in the defense of Akros against harpies and cyclopses.
events.quote: Drasus was part of the defense of Akros against harpies and cyclopses

events.summary: Drasus was killed with the other irregulars when Erebos returned Heliod's spear.
events.quote: He was killed along with the other irregulars when Heliod 's spear thrown by Kytheon was returned by Erebos
